items.summary: Canada-U.S. Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc will chair a meeting of the Advisory Committee on Canada-U.S. Economic Relations Thursday, CTV News has learned.

items.title: Meta would 'consider' pulling services from Canada if lawful access bill passes as is
items.summary: Representatives from Meta say the social media company would have to "consider" pulling encryption services from Canada if the government's proposed lawful access bill passes without further changes.

items.title: Police say same 17-year-old suspect now wanted in two Etobicoke murders
items.summary: Toronto police say a 17-year-old who was already wanted in connection with a recent murder in Etobicoke is now wanted in connection with another that took place days later.

items.title: Trump bristles at criticism over grounding of planes, blaming old tech and Biden for the problems
items.summary: The government wants to be certain it determines the “root cause” of the problems that led to the grounding of planes across the United States before making broad fixes to air traffic control, the nation’s transportation chief said Sunday.

items.title: Mayor Chow fields questions about investigation into TTC CEO Mandeep Lali
items.summary: Olivia Chow will be announcing appointments to key positions in her administration Thursday as she embarks on her second term as Toronto’s mayor following her reelection in last month’s municipal election.

items.title: 'We slept here': Flight delays linger as airlines recover from ground stop, but schedule improves Monday
items.summary: Flight disruptions lingered two days after the Federal Aviation Administration grounded departures nationwide for more than four hours.

items.title: How Airbnb cofounder and US Design Chief Joe Gebbia fixed a $100 million government problem for $1.5 million
items.summary: The US chief design officer says ex-Airbnb engineers brought federal retirement online in six months. Now he wants to do the same for 29,000 government websites.
